items.name: Don't Breathe
items.summary:
Su-Yeong, a man who lost his aspirations in an unforeseen accident, sets off on a cruise with his younger sister, Hee-Su. Yet, a strange virus begins to spread across the island, leading to attacks by monsters that take human heads. Su-Yeong finds himself separated from his sister, with the only route to safety lying in the vast ocean. Will he manage to locate his sister and escape the cruise unharmed?

items.summary: Suhyeon, who has spent 30 years being single, meets an untimely end in a traffic accident and encounters a mysterious figure that identifies as a "god." This "god" presents him with an opportunity to live again, but with the condition that Suhyeon must transform into an incubus instead of remaining human, relying on the vital energy of men to survive…

items.name: The Spirit Suppressing Museum
items.summary:
When spiritual energy reemerges in the world, it does so with great noise...  

Ancient demons stir from slumber. Forgotten monsters emerge. Humanity teeters on the brink of chaos.  

Wei Yuan never intended to get involved—until destiny bestowed upon him a mysterious token carved with a tiger from the era of Emperor Wu of Han. In that instant, his life transformed forever.  

He becomes the last Sili Xiaowei—a forgotten title revived in the contemporary world.  

But this is merely the beginning.  

The Jiangnan Folklore Museum, where he resides, is far from ordinary. Hidden within its silent corridors lies a chilling reality: it serves as a living seal, confining countless demons, ghosts, and ancient terrors. Every artifact bears a tale… and within each tale lurks a lethal secret.  

Equipped with an eight-sided Han sword and weighed down by a legacy lost to the sands of time, Wei Yuan must confront the darkness that resides within history itself.  

From age-old legends to present-day nightmares…  

He will encounter them all.  

And this time—nothing remains buried.

items.summary: Read manhwa The Male Lead Is Unhealthily Obsessed With My Health / I found myself reincarnated as an extra, the nonexistent childhood friend of the male lead, who meets an early demise in the story. I can't even dodge the impending dead flag. Thus, I continue living like this: "Why aren't you healthy?" "I'm healthy." "Why are you sick again? Did I allow you to be sick?" The male lead has become fixated on my well-being. Oh, could someone please get rid of this guy! I was surely reincarnated as an extra with no significance. However, my new existence is taking an odd turn. "Why are you doing this for me?" "Because I like you." Suddenly, the cheerful male lead began to cling to me... "Mom, do it for me." "I'm a man." And there’s a handsome guardian who has taken on the role of my mother (gender: male) saying, "Hello, daughter!" Even a father who was meant to die has shown up before me. Moreover... "From today on, I'm your dad." A dubious individual is trying to become my father. Why did I find myself in this undeserved predicament as an extra? Can I truly become healthy?

items.alt_name: Undead Calamity: With a Wave of My Hand, a Million Skeletons Rise
items.summary: As the age of class awakenings begins in the world, Wei Xiao discovers the concealed class of Necromancer. Armed with merely a rusty shovel, he conjures Skeleton Mages with a mere gesture and continuously enlarges his undead legion. By overwhelming bosses through sheer numbers, annihilating everything in his way, and clearing entire battlefields single-handedly— When the unending ocean of bones arrives, all living creatures have no choice but to submit. Mastering life and death, commanding an army all on his own, Wei Xiao transforms into a calamity dreaded by the entire world. Consequently, from that moment forth, a phrase circulates throughout the land: Wei Xiao is the Calamity itself.

items.name: Jewel Witch
items.summary: Jelack, a witch created from a jewel, aspires to participate in the witches’ gathering, but is her colorful outfit the reason for her rejection? The traditional witches refuse to welcome her. Determined, Jelack embarks on a lengthy adventure to discover a witches’ gathering that will embrace her. Along the way, she becomes involved with three men… Will Jelack successfully gain entry to the witches’ gathering?

items.name: Teto X Egen
items.summary: Haeseon, a determined "Teto girl" whose whole existence is centered on her profession, and Seonho, a reserved "Egen guy" who desires nothing more than to remain at home with his cat. Existing in completely distinct realms, the two are like parallel lines meant to never intersect. However, they are unexpectedly thrust together on the same Task Force team—and to complicate things further, they find out they are neighbors! As their everyday lives become inextricably intertwined, Seonho's "first love" unexpectedly makes an appearance…! What will unfold in this chaotic, anxiety-inducing, and oddly heart-fluttering romance between two total opposites?

items.name: Melanco Killing

While she is repeating the year to have another shot, her troubled ex-boyfriend Junha unexpectedly comes back into her life. Is he back to interfere with her studies again… or does he still have feelings for her? This is a steamy campus romantic comedy featuring two individuals who are vastly different yet undeniably attracted to one another.

items.name: The Investor Who Sees the Future
items.summary:
Following an incident while serving in the military, Kang Jinhu acquired the power to predict the future. 

He chooses to leverage this talent to invest in different companies and generate wealth, with the goal of becoming the top investor in the world. 

To what extent does his foresight reach? It influences not only investments but also economics, politics, corporations, and even international matters. From this point onward, he is transforming the financial landscape!

items.name: Goblin Inc.
items.summary: Section Chief Oh, a typical office employee, unexpectedly finds himself transported to the Demon World instead of heading to work. Upon awakening, he discovers that he has become a Goblin Lord on the verge of extinction. In order to survive, he must resort to thievery; to keep living, he must achieve dominance. With the determination of a salaryman, he transforms the very fabric of the Demon World.

items.name: Fox Groom
items.summary:
When she was ten, Wanseo survived after eating the Peach of Immortality of the Queen Mother of the West. For a long time, she has secretly loved Ho, a nine-tailed fox. As Wanseo grows older, the scent of peaches around her becomes stronger, causing her to become a target for yokai. While her father goes to meet the Heavenly Emperor about the matter, Ho is assigned to protect her. In the process, Ho’s heart slowly begins to waver, and eventually, a proposal letter arrives from the Heavenly Emperor, ordering her to choose a spouse and enter into an engagement...

items.name: Imoogi and the Monk
items.summary: “Will you become my consort, Your Highness?” * Ye Do-ha, born as the Crown Prince of Yejin Kingdom and endowed with the constitution of an extreme Yang. He was destined to become king. Until he re-manifested as an Yin after spending the night in a feverish state… One day, while he was praying for the drought-stricken Yejin Kingdom after being expelled from the palace and becoming a monk, an old friend visited his quiet and lonely hermitage. “I wish to bring rain for you. If I bring rain for Your Highness, what do you intend to do for me?” That night, he gave away all the secrets and desires he harbored to his friend… “Now that I see it, Your Highness and I seem to be a match made in heaven. Just as I have two of them, Your Highness has two holes.” The sweet rain they had so longed for finally fell upon Yejin Kingdom. Perhaps, after all, this was their destiny.				+

items.summary: A college student named Sakurai Hiroki was transported to another world with the mission to defeat the Demon Lord. Given that he received the "Priest" job, his initial Recovery Stat was sufficient to heal any injuries, prompting him to allocate all of his Stat Points to Evasion. Essentially, he is striving to become an Evasion Healer who can completely avoid enemy attacks. However, the inhabitants of this world failed to grasp his vision! The King quickly became furious with him and branded him as worthless! Thus begins the tale of how Hiroki transforms into a unique Healer capable of effortlessly dodging attacks from the Dungeon Boss!

items.name: My Step-Daughters Are The Villainesses
items.summary:
“Keep your friends close, but your enemies closer.”

That was Ulrich’s thought when he decided to adopt the three villainesses as daughters of his House despite knowing they were destined to be his doom in the novel he now found himself in.

But he greatly underestimated the consequences and the burden that came with it....

He should have known that adopting the three most dangerous witches in the world wasn’t just a bad idea, it was a disaster waiting to happen.

Now, he was forced to face the fallout of his decision while also facing his role as the hated professor of the story’s protagonists and heroines!
